sql_json: SELECT frogql_traverse('knowledge_graph_geography', 'MATCH (l:Location)-[:LocatedIn]->(aa:AdministrativeArea) WHERE aa.population > 1000000 GROUP BY aa.name RETURN aa.name, AVG(l.elevation) AS avg_elevation')
